title: Fibo 2.0 · Any subject
blurb: A person, a pet, a product or a look, on Bria’s Fibo 2.0 Dev. It learns fast, at a low rank and a gentle learning rate.
note: Bria’s own recipe (rank 64, 8 accumulated samples) is the Fibo 2.0 profile in the full form
notes: From a run that trained well: AdamW 3e-5, rank 16, 3000 steps on ~120 photos (~25 a photo). Fibo moves fast: 1e-4 on single samples had rebuilt a 12-image test's whole look in 30 steps.
caption.style: Fibo is trained on, and prompted with, structured JSON captions (Bria's VGL format).
